AGE GAP – Telugu Web Series ❤️

Does age really matter in love? Or can two hearts fall in love despite the difference? ❤️‍🔥

Roshan is a fun-loving young man who enjoys life, friends, and his carefree lifestyle.
Shanti, on the other hand, is a strong and responsible woman who puts her family’s needs before her own dreams.

Two completely different lives…
Two completely different worlds…

But one unexpected connection is about to bring them together. A simple chunni becomes the beginning of a journey neither of them expected. ❤️

As Roshan starts searching for the mysterious girl who has captured his heart, Shanti is struggling with family responsibilities, financial problems, and pressure to get married.

And when their paths finally cross, things start getting complicated…

Will their growing bond turn into love?
Will their age difference become a problem?
Can they face their families and society for the person they truly love?
And most importantly… will their love story have a happy ending? 👀❤️

AGE GAP is a refreshing Telugu romantic family drama filled with love, comedy, emotions, friendship, family conflicts, and unexpected twists.
